name: Even-Parity Class
definition: The **even-parity class** is $\mathcal E_n=\{A\subseteq[n]:|A|\text{ is even}\}$, viewed as a binary concept class on the domain $[n]$.
comments: Every two distinct concepts at Hamming distance one have opposite parity, so the $1$-inclusion graph of $\mathcal E_n$ is edgeless.
